item.tib: gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod
item.coloph: ces de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi rigs sngags rgyal mo'i rgyud las sa chog bum las kyi rim pa 'di ni/ rtsa grogs las slob bstan sbyin du gyur pa rnams kyi snga phyi kun tu gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas/ snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i don du gnyer ba'i kun grol grags pa bdag gis shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams su 'byor ba'i tshes/ sa pho rta yi lo la bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan pa'i rgyan du gyur nas 'gro ba'i sman du shog cig gi smon pa dang bcas ithi//
